scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:frontend && npm run package:functions-shared && npm run build --workspace @travel-planner/functions
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:functions: npm run build:shared && npm run package:functions-shared && npm run build --workspace @travel-planner/functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace @travel-planner/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @travel-planner/functions
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:emulator
